**A.** Both responses exceed the 120-word limit, but A is only slightly over, at about 126 words. B runs to roughly 170 words, so it breaks the constraint much more badly.

A also stays faithful to the source. B adds a "net cost of about $33,000" figure that the article never states. The $19,000 was staff time, which may not be a real saving. B also pads with phrases like "It is also worth noting" and "To make sure the policy is working as intended."

A is tighter and easier for a busy manager to scan.

A
